cash.clawed_back: An admin took back {amount} of your pay for {mission}
payments.toast.forfeited: An admin ended the dispute window: the held {amount} of a voided run is forfeited
payments.toast.cancelled: An admin cancelled a payment of {amount}. The run keeps its points.
payments.health.account: Config.Cash.account is "{account}": it must be bank or cash, or every payment waits
payments.health.no_account: {department}: the Renewed-Banking account "{account}" does not exist, so its pay is unfunded
payments.health.low: {department}: the account has {balance}, below the warning level of {limit}
rewards.cancelled: An admin cancelled one of your item rewards
err.payment_in_flight: This officer is being paid right now. Try again in a moment.
err.officer_offline: The officer must be online for this.
err.unfunded_now: The department account can't cover this now. Nothing was paid.
err.payment_raised: Qbox or Renewed-Banking failed in the middle of the payment. It stays for a manual check.
err.payment_refused: Qbox refused the payment. Nothing was paid.
err.payment_arrived: The step marker says the money arrived. Mark it paid instead.
err.payment_step_unknown: This payment is older than the step markers and the department may have paid already. Check Renewed-Banking and mark it paid, or pay by hand.
err.nothing_to_pay: There is nothing left to pay.
err.audit_failed: The audit log could not be written, so nothing was done.
err.balance_low: The balance is too low for this.
err.clawback_refused: Qbox refused to take the money. Nothing was taken.
err.clawback_too_much: That is more than was paid (minus what was taken back before).
err.money_tool_off: This money tool is turned off. An admin can turn it on in Settings (type ENABLE).
err.check_first: Tick "I checked: the money did not arrive" first.
err.manual_limit: This goes over your daily limit for manual cash payments.
err.fund_failed: Renewed-Banking refused the deposit. Nothing was added.
err.reward_busy: This officer's rewards are being given right now. Try again in a moment.
err.reward_found: The item is in the officer's inventory, so it was given.
err.reward_not_in_inventory: The tagged item is not (all) in the officer's inventory any more.
err.reward_pool_shape: An item reward needs an item name; a pool needs a list of items.
err.reward_item_forbidden: That item can never be an item reward (weapons, ammo, armour, bandages, money).
err.reward_count: The count must be a whole number from 1 to 100 (or a low and a high count).
err.reward_chance: A chance must be from 0 to 1.
err.reward_rolls: Rolls must be a whole number from 0 to 10.
err.cleanup_failed: The clean-up stopped with an error. See System → Problems.
admin.payouts.adjust_desc: Change many payouts at once by a percentage or a fixed amount. Each new value stays inside the payout range. You see every old and new value before anything changes.
admin.payouts.adjust_lock_desc: Off: each type keeps its lock as it is now. On: every changed type becomes admin-locked.
admin.payouts.adjust_confirm: These payouts change for every run accepted from now on. Each value is logged.
admin.payouts.unlock_desc: Keeps this amount, and supervisors may move it again within their range around the Config payout.
admin.payouts.unlock_msg: The payout stays {amount}. Supervisors may change it again within their range.
admin.payouts.out_of_range_note: {n} stored payouts are outside the payout range ({min}–{max}). They still pay what was set: change or clear them below.
admin.rewards.resolve_offline: The officer is offline, so the inventory can't be checked. Try again when they are online.
admin.rewards.resolve_found: Found in the officer's inventory ({count}): it was given.
admin.rewards.resolve_not_found: Not found in the inventory. The item may have been used, dropped or moved, so the safe answer is "given". Back to the locker gives it again.
admin.rewards.outcome_locker: Back to the locker (gives it again)
admin.rewards.action_msg.deliver: Give {name} every reward waiting in the locker now.
admin.rewards.action_msg.cancel: {item} for {name} is forfeited. The run keeps its points and its cash.
admin.rewards.action_msg.takeBack: Take {item} back from {name}'s inventory. Only the exact item this reward gave is removed.
funds.title: Funds
funds.not_used: Not used now (cash comes from the server)
funds.turned_off: Department turned off: its pay still comes from here
funds.add_msg: This is new money in the {account} account (at most {max} at a time). It is logged and posted to the audit webhook.
payments.subtitle: Every payment of every run: what it earned, what was paid and why the rest was not.
payments.step.claimed: Claimed: no money moved yet, or the department withdrawal failed half way
payments.step.withdrawn: The department already paid; the officer's deposit did not finish
payments.held: Payments are held by the maintenance lock. They are paid after the restart.
payments.effect.rest: The part the daily cap cut
payments.action_msg.payNow: Pay {name} now. Paid only while they are online; otherwise it stays pending until they log in.
payments.action_msg.unfunded: Pay {name}'s {amount} from the department account now that it has money. The balance is checked first.
payments.action_msg.unfunded_all: Pay every unfunded payment below from the department account. The balance must cover the total.
payments.action_msg.capRest: Pay {name} the part of this payment the daily cap cut. This goes over the officer's daily cap.
payments.action_msg.repay: Pay {name} the {amount} this run forfeited. Its item rewards come back too.
payments.action_msg.forfeitNow: End {name}'s dispute window now: the held {amount} is forfeited and never paid.
payments.action_msg.cancel: Cancel {name}'s {amount}. The run keeps its points; the officer gets a message.
payments.action_msg.clawback: Take cash back from {name}'s bank. Only while they are online and only if their balance covers it. The department gets it back when it paid it.
payments.manual.title: Pay an officer by hand
payments.manual.desc: For a correction ("the payout was wrong, here is $200"). Your daily limit is {limit}, counted from today's payments.
payments.manual.cap_note: Not counted against the daily cash cap, and not cut by it. Paid from the normal source; it waits until the officer logs in when they are offline.
payments.resolve.title: Resolve {name}'s payment
payments.resolve.desc: This payment stopped half way. Check what Renewed-Banking recorded, then mark it paid or pay it again.
payments.resolve.nothing_proves: "Not found" proves nothing: Renewed-Banking keeps a history only for players it had loaded. Check the officer's balance too.
payments.resolve.offline: The officer is offline: Pay again needs them online.
payments.resolve.mark_paid_msg: The money arrived. No money moves; the payment is marked paid.
payments.resolve.pay_again_msg: The money did not arrive. It is paid again with its own transaction id; a department that already paid is never charged twice.
payments.resolve.checked: I checked: the money did not arrive
rewardpool.key: Name (type, mission, medal, goal, level or season key)
